_note: D-SILENT-TURN-NO-CARD-NO-PROSE — three of the EIGHT trigger scenarios the row names, extracted VERBATIM and run together so the trigger is exercised deliberately rather than hoped for. The row's own caution is why: 'a zero is the absence of the TRIGGER unless the trigger is shown to have fired', and its recent zeros were all incidental.

scenarios.prompt: Read arc — show me the arc detail for The Hollow Keep.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM structure_node WHERE book_id='{book_id}' AND kind='arc' AND title LIKE '%Hollow Keep%'
seed_assert.why: THE ARC MUST EXIST — this is the fixture that batch 4 could not build, which is why composition_conformance_run refused correctly and was scored as a miss. The tool takes a node_id, so the model must resolve the arc's NAME to it.

answer_expect.why: The seeded arc is the only one; naming it is the minimum evidence that the arc was actually read rather than described.

scenarios.falsifier: RE-RUN AFTER THE WHITESPACE ARM (an `*_id` containing a space is a NAME). v1 was called 3/3 with node_id='The Hollow Keep' and node_id='arc_1'; the tool refused correctly but only after a round trip, and one reply told the author the arc 'hasn't been planned yet' while the seed assertion proved it exists. REFUTED IF a NAME again reaches the tool as node_id. EXPECTED: it is dropped and reported missing, so the model lists the arcs and resolves the id.

ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a node_id that does not exist must be refused, and must be distinguishable from an arc that exists but is empty (D-ABSENT-ENTITY-READS-AS-UNUSED).

scenarios.prompt: Is there anything waiting for my review in this book?
scenarios.prompt_source: _meta.synonyms['waiting for my review'] + ['anything to review'] — phrasings this tool gained in D-DECLARE-THE-USERS-WORD, which took it from surfaced 0/3 to called 3/3.

sql.statement: UPDATE glossary_entities SET tags = '{}' WHERE book_id='{book_id}' AND cached_name <> 'Mira Solene'
sql.why: 🔴 INVERTED, because glossary_propose_entities TAGS EVERY PROPOSED ENTITY 'ai-suggested' itself — measured directly. The first version tagged Mira and expected the other two to be untagged; all three were tagged and the seed assertion failed loudly, which is the batch-2 lesson working. Strip the tag from the two that must NOT be in the queue instead.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM glossary_entities WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
SELECT count(*)::text FROM glossary_entities WHERE book_id='{book_id}' AND 'ai-suggested' = ANY(tags)
seed_assert.why: EXACTLY ONE is ai-suggested. 🔴 Batch 2 measured the alternative: with all three tagged, 'three suggested entries' was CORRECT and a fabrication could not be told from a reading. One-of-three is what makes the count discriminate.

answer_expect.why: Exactly one entry is awaiting review and it is Mira Solene. Reporting three is reporting the entity count, which is the batch-2 defect reproducing.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a read-intent turn changes the store, OR the reply reports a review-queue size other than 1, OR it names an entity that is not tagged ai-suggested.

ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — a book with nothing awaiting review must say so rather than list every entity.

scenarios.prompt: Show me the full detail of my most recent job — status, cost, and whether anything failed.
scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: the reply reports a job's status, cost or error WITHOUT jobs_get being called on the turn — jobs_list carries a summary, so an answer assembled from the list while claiming full detail is the registry-vs-live shape again. CONTROL: jobs_get REQUIRES service + job_id, and only jobs_list supplies them, so a correct turn is a two-call chain; a turn calling only jobs_list has not reached the tool under test. If the account has no jobs at all the run is VOID, not a pass — check before concluding.

ship_audit.empty_case: OWED — an account with no jobs must say so, not invent one.
ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a job_id that does not exist must return 'not found or not accessible', and that string must not distinguish another user's job from a nonexistent one.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — user-scoped; another account's job_id must be refused.
